faq_heading: Boundary Beach condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Boundary Beach sell for?
faq.a: 8 townhomes sold in Boundary Beach between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,199,900.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Boundary Beach?
faq.a: The median was 4 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 100.0% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Boundary Beach sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 8 townhomes that sold in Boundary Beach went for between $1,032,425 and $1,263,675, around a median of $1,199,900.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Boundary Beach sell above asking price?
faq.a: 12% of the 8 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 100.0% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Boundary Beach?
faq.a: Of the 8 sales, 8 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $569.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Boundary Beach?
faq.a: The median year built was 2024 for the 8 townhomes sold in Boundary Beach.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Boundary Beach usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Boundary Beach had 3 bedrooms, from the 8 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach condos and townhomes for sale now
What Boundary Beach condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

8 townhomes sold in Boundary Beach with a median price of $1,199,900 (the middle half sold between $1,032,425 and $1,263,675), taking a median of 4 days to sell at 100.0% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $690 per square foot, a median year built of 2024 and a median strata fee of $569 a month. 7 condos sold in Boundary Beach with a median price of $715,000, taking a median of 21 days to sell at 98.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $844 per square foot, a median year built of 2024 and a median strata fee of $464 a month.

blocks.text: How Boundary Beach compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median townhome in Boundary Beach sold for $1,199,900, 56% above the Tsawwassen median of $767,450 across 60 sales. Boundary Beach townhomes took a median 4 days to sell, against 35 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.
